fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The spacing of a Turing pattern at onset is set by the reaction rates and diffusivities, not by the size of the tissue, so changing these parameters predictably changes the number of repeated elements.

fields.label: Notation
fields.value: at onset k_c^2 = \sqrt{\det J/(D_u D_v)}, \lambda_c = 2\pi/k_c; under uniform rescaling of D, \lambda \propto \sqrt{D}

fields.label: Source as written
fields.value: Alan Turing (1952) The chemical basis of morphogenesis

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: Cursor agent (Claude Opus 5.5) extracting key claims from source papers

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: near onset of instability, two species, domain large compared with the wavelength

fields.label: Formal status in the nanopub
fields.value: proved by linear analysis. Away from onset, the selected wavelength depends on nonlinear terms and history.

fields.label: Notation
fields.value: at onset k_c^2 = \sqrt{\det J/(D_u D_v)}, \lambda_c = 2\pi/k_c; under uniform rescaling of D, \lambda \propto \sqrt{D}

fields.label: Proposed test
fields.value: Alter morphogen production, degradation or diffusion in a developing tissue (e.g. Hox dosage or Bmp/Wnt inhibition in mouse limb buds) and test whether digit or element number changes in the direction and proportion the dispersion relation predicts.
